President Trump said in a phone interview on Friday that the U.S. is currently "talking" with the Houthis, and claimed the group is looking to secure a deal.
 
He also repeated his insistence that Iran wants to make a deal saying, "We’ll see what happens." https://t.co/H4nvu4eTUP

A Florida couple is accusing the fertility clinic they used for IVF of negligence after a blood test revealed the clinic used an unidentified man’s sperm to create their daughter’s embryo.

ABC News' Hanna Battah has the story. https://t.co/lU1vG01GoM https://t.co/8qVIdrtgks
